title: Link checker and markdown lint in CI
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. The docs cite hundreds of external sources; dead links weaken the evidence base. Depends on: ridebelt-traceability-001 (do those first or use their outputs if merged).
objective: Add a GitHub Actions workflow that checks internal and external links and lints markdown on every PR, with a scheduled weekly external-link run.
acceptanceCriteria: Uses maintained open-source actions pinned to a version
Internal broken links fail the build; external failures report without blocking
Current repo passes, or found problems are fixed in the PR
